dict.string: Wythin uses Bluetooth to receive live heart rate and beat intervals from your Polar H10 or Garmin HRM-Pro Plus.
Wythin uses Bluetooth to receive live heart rate and beat intervals from your Polar H10 or Garmin HRM-Pro Plus.
Wythin reads your workouts and available heart rate, HRV, energy, distance and steps to show measurements before, during and after activity.
Wythin uses Apple Health to show activity measurements. Wythin only reads the data you allow and does not save or change data in Apple Health.
